subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): scope memory_recall and memory_forget in a shared store

question: Should bundled memory-lancedb ship caller-selected scopes now as a non-security partition primitive, before trusted session binding and scope-targeted automatic recall exist?
rationale: The code can implement either direction safely, but source inspection cannot decide whether explicit scoped tools alone provide enough product value to justify the persistent schema and upgrade contract.

options.title: Approve explicit partitions now
options.body: Ship the documented caller-selected partition primitive with the coordinated doctor migration and track trusted automatic-recall binding separately.

options.title: Require active-scope integration
options.body: Hold this PR until the runtime supplies a trusted current-context scope used consistently by capture, recall, and forget.

options.title: Pause bundled scope support
options.body: Close or defer the bundled feature and leave advanced multi-scope memory behavior to separately maintained plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit partitions now
recommendation.body: Ship the documented caller-selected partition primitive with the coordinated doctor migration and track trusted automatic-recall binding separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available repository-level owner for accepting a new bundled memory data and UX contract.
